data.name: Delkash
data.gender_notes: Delkash is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'D-L-K', meaning 'power', 'ability' or 'might'. In Islamic context, it represents the divine power and strength of Allah. The name Delkash carries the meaning “God's power” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Delkash usually hope their child will grow to embody god's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the strength and power of Allah.
data.etymology: Delkash belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Delkash total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
